intent: OWNER describes outcome, inputs, outputs and constraints. System chooses component kinds. A type picker is never a prerequisite. OWNER may edit proposed kinds.
classification: No supported API and authorized UI available => BROWSER_AUTOMATION
Combine kinds into distinct components when boundaries require it
draftAuthority: one canonical immutable revision series; graphical edits and natural-language edits compile into the same propose command with expectedRevision and typed changes

stateMachine.guard: all schemas, dependency graph, credentials requirements and impact checks PASS for exact digest
OWNER explicitly confirms same revisionDigest; CAS on current revision
creates successor revision, discards prior review and approval
new immutable revision; running production keeps approved old digest; never mutate running contract

graphValidation: Unique IDs and port names; every endpoint resolves to existing or planned component
JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 port schemas must compile; refs restricted to locked shared-contract catalog
BUILD and STARTUP dependency edges must form a DAG; reject cycles with complete cycle path
RUNTIME cycles require bounded messages, dedupe, timeout and dead-letter contract; otherwise reject
Topological build order with lexicographic component ID tiebreak; build shared contracts before consumers
Missing future component is a planned ID, not COMPONENT_NOT_FOUND; missing schema or business input blocks REVIEWED
Deleting component reports impacted edges; owner edits or deletes each dangling binding before review
Generation run binds specificationId/revision/digest; children carry same root correlation and their exact component revision
Validate all components and bindings, then activate set atomically; failed child blocks whole-set success
Repair only failed/unverified nodes; confirmed effects require reconciliation, never duplicate generation dispatch
parallelism: Only independent DAG nodes can run concurrently within canonical capacity budget; display child progress separately
revisionDigest: SHA256 of RFC8785 canonical {goal,components,bindings,contracts}; approval metadata excluded; recompute server-side
secrets: Store Secret IDs and destinations; never Secret values in specification graph
externalRuntime: LOCAL_UBUNTU default for every generated component; external target requires explicit OWNER requirement and recorded deployment target
